title: Natural quasi-isomorphism before additive total transport
statement: Let $A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], let $C$ be a preadditive category with a zero object and finite coproducts, let $\iota:C\to A$ be fully faithful and additive [def-weil-pbc-additive-functor], and let $\Lambda$ be a left-resolution datum [lem-sfb-left-resolution-reduced-api] for $\iota$ whose functor preserves zero morphisms. For an integer cochain complex $K$ in $A$ whose terms vanish in all sufficiently large degrees [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], form the resolution bicomplex $B_K$ of [lem-sfb-left-resolution-bicomplex-total-exists] and the row bicomplex concentrated in degree $0$, with totals formed from their diagonal coproducts. The total map $\tau_K:\operatorname{Tot}(\iota B_K)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Tot}(\operatorname{singleRow}_0(K))$ induced columnwise by the augmentations $\iota R(K^p)\to K^p[0]$ of [lem-sfb-left-resolution-objectwise-cochain] is natural in $K$ and is a quasi-isomorphism.

source.place: bicomplexπ, totalπ′, its naturality, and the columnwise quasi-isomorphism comparison, lines 151–206

proof.text: Choose an upper bound $b$ with $K^p=0$ for $p>b$. By [lem-sfb-left-resolution-bicomplex-total-exists], the resolution bicomplex $B_K$ and its termwise image under $\iota$ have the required diagonal totals; the row bicomplex also has its total by [lem-sfb-left-resolution-single-row-total]. The natural objectwise augmentations of [lem-sfb-left-resolution-objectwise-cochain] assemble, by the definition of the bicomplex map, to a morphism $\operatorname{bicomplex}\pi$ from the termwise image of $B_K$ to the single-row bicomplex. Applying the total-map construction to this morphism defines $\tau_K$ with the stated source and target.

source.place: bicomplexπ and totalπ′ definitions, lines 151–165; total-existence instances, lines 91–108

proof.text: For a cochain map $\phi:K\to L$, compare the two composites $\operatorname{Tot}(\iota B_\phi)$ followed by $\tau_L$ and $\tau_K$ followed by $\operatorname{Tot}(\operatorname{singleRow}_0(\phi))$. Both are totals of bicomplex maps, and the total construction is functorial, so it suffices to compare the two composite bicomplex maps $\iota B_K\to\operatorname{singleRow}_0(L)$ in every bidegree $(p,q)$. For $q\neq0$ the target $\operatorname{singleRow}_0(L)^{p,q}$ is zero, so both components vanish. For $q=0$ the components are $\pi_{L^p}\circ\iota R(\phi^p)^0$ and $\phi^p\circ\pi_{K^p}$, which agree by the naturality of the augmentation $\iota R(X)\to X[0]$ in $X$ stated in [lem-sfb-left-resolution-objectwise-cochain], applied to $\phi^p:K^p\to L^p$; the functoriality of the row bicomplex in $K$ is that of [lem-sfb-left-resolution-single-row-total]. This is exactly the displayed naturality equation for $\tau$, and hence the maps $\tau_K$ are natural in $K$.

The $p$-th column of the bicomplex morphism of step 1 is the augmentation $\iota R(K^p)\to K^p[0]$, which is a quasi-isomorphism by [lem-sfb-left-resolution-objectwise-cochain]. For the source $\iota B_K$, [lem-sfb-left-resolution-bicomplex-total-exists] gives the total and the vanishing of every column with first index $p>b$ and of every term with $q>0$. For the target $\operatorname{singleRow}_0(K)$, the total exists by [lem-sfb-left-resolution-single-row-total], and its $p$-th column is $K^p$ placed in degree $0$; so it is zero for $p>b$ (where $K^p=0$) and every column vanishes in degrees $q>0$ (elementary, from the definition of the row bicomplex). Thus the hypotheses of [lem-pc-bounded-above-double-complex-total-comparison] hold for both bicomplexes with first-index bound $x_0=b$ and second-index bound $y_0=0$, in the abelian category $A$. Applying it shows that the induced total map $\tau_K$ is a quasi-isomorphism.
